acceptanceCriteria: `attempt heartbeat` and `attempt renew` help state that a renew also records liveness, backed by a test that a renew-only holder never reads STALE_HOLDER within the lease.
Queue policy exposes a heartbeat TTL (default 600 s, unchanged) shown by `policy show`, with spec requirements, bounds and a test that a longer TTL avoids STALE_HOLDER at a matching cadence.
Existing stores and policies read unchanged; GitHub #982 receives a comment linking the merged PR.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#982 comment (2026-10-16). (1) Callers pair heartbeat+renew every tick a renew is due (74/74 renews in one day), though a renew records lastHeartbeatAt (CAL-V0-231); sending only renew removes ~20-30% of liveness writes. Add a note to `attempt heartbeat`/`attempt renew` help; check whether STALE_HOLDER still appears with renew alone (local orchestration still pairs them per earlier V1-1313 observation). (2) heartbeatTTLSeconds is fixed at 600 and not exposed by `policy show`; a policy-level TTL (default unchanged, e.g. 1800 for long holders) would cut heartbeat volume ~4x without STALE_HOLDER risk. Complements V1-1508 (elide-in-place retention).
title: corvint-tasks: document renew-only liveness and make heartbeat TTL a policy setting (GitHub #982 follow-ups)
